distributions.debian.sourceslist:
deb http://http.debian.net/debian %(release)s main
deb-src http://http.debian.net/debian %(release)s main
distributions.ubuntu.sourceslist:
deb http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s main universe restricted multiverse
deb-src http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s main universe restricted multiverse

deb http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu %(release)s-security main universe restricted multiverse
deb-src http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu %(release)s-security main universe restricted multiverse

deb http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s-updates main universe restricted multiverse
deb-src http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ %(release)s-updates main universe restricted multiverse
